All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE:** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` contains 3 panels, titled exactly: `Request rate`, `Error count`, `Latency by endpoint`.

**Objective 2 — DONE:** New dashboard `c2gr2 Bench Dashboard` exists and is saved. It contains a **Stat** panel titled `c2gr2 Availability` whose query editor shows the data source `TestData` (verified by opening the panel in the editor: visualization type "Stat", data source "TestData", title "c2gr2 Availability").

**Objective 3 — DONE:** The dashboard also contains a **Text** panel titled `c2gr2 Notes` whose rendered content is `Notes for run c2gr2` (includes the runid). Saved.

**Objective 4 — DONE:** Dashboard Settings > General shows exactly one tag: `bench`. The time range picker shows `Last 6 hours` when the dashboard is opened with no URL query parameters (i.e. persisted as the dashboard default, not just a URL param). Saved.

**Objective 5 — DONE:** The refresh-rate picker shows `1m` when the dashboard is opened with no URL query parameters. Note: initially setting it from the top-bar picker only wrote a `?refresh=1m` URL param; I then persisted it via Dashboard Settings > General "Auto refresh" field plus the save dialog's "Update default refresh value" option, and re-verified on a clean URL. Saved.

**Objective 6 — DONE:** Dashboard URL: `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efwa4qt4tbv9cc/c2gr2-bench-dashboard` — UID: `efwa4qt4tbv9cc`.

Final state re-verified on a clean load (no query params): title `c2gr2 Bench Dashboard`; panels `c2gr2 Notes` and `c2gr2 Availability`; time range `Last 6 hours`; refresh `1m`; text panel content includes `c2gr2`; tags field contains `bench`.
